name: Prompt Injection and Agent Security
description: A deep course on prompt injection: why it exists, how direct, indirect and multimodal payloads turn into data exfiltration and goal hijack in agents, why filters alone fail against adaptive attackers, and which architectural patterns and tests actually reduce risk.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Prompt Injection and Agent Security

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 17 lessons in 5 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 45 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
